Exam: mpMRI Prostate
Clinical indication: PSA 12.4 ng/mL, prior biopsy Gleason 3+4, PI-RADS 3
FINDINGS: Prostate volume measures 149.0 mL. T2-weighted imaging demonstrates a focal area of hypointensity in the left peripheral zone, approximately 12 mm in craniocaudal dimension. This region shows restricted diffusion on DWI/ADC maps with corresponding subtle enhancement on DCE sequences. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is identified. No suspicious lymphadenopathy or osseous lesions.
IMPRESSION: PI-RADS 3 lesion in the left peripheral zone. Prostate-specific antigen density 0.08 ng/mL/mL. Clinical stage cT1c. csPCa predicted probability 0.58010316.
